post.description: Read one icon using its ID from search, including image dimensions, source links and an agent-ready Markdown reference. Each call costs 5 credits.

id.description: Stable icon ID from search, including mac- or win-prefixed IDs.

200.description:
One icon with image URL, provenance and Markdown reference. Optional chartRank, chartCategory and appVersion depend on the source.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Stable icon ID: the App Store ID, or a mac-/win- prefixed slug. |
| `name` | string | Reviewed display name. |
| `category` | string | category |
| `platform` | string | platform |
| `publisher` | string | publisher |
| `imageUrl` | string | Hosted PNG of the icon. |
| `width` | number | width |
| `height` | number | height |
| `featured` | boolean | Shown in the featured section of the site. |
| `pageUrl` | string | The icon on icons.computer. |
| `sourceName` | string | Title in the source store or gallery. |
| `source` | string | source |
| `sourceUrl` | string | sourceUrl |
| `originalImageUrl` | string | Where the icon was retrieved from; for installer-exported macOS icons, the installer. |
| `format` | string | format |
| `retrievedAt` | string | retrievedAt |
| `chartRank` | number | Rank in the US App Store top-free chart for chartCategory, when the icon came from a chart. |
| `chartCategory` | string | chartCategory |
| `appVersion` | string | App version the icon was exported from, for installer-exported macOS icons. |
| `markdown` | string | Markdown reference for agents, as copied by the site. |

post.description: Find app icons by app name or a description such as purple icons or animal icon. Filter by category or platform. Default sort ranks query matches first. Each call costs 5 credits.

q.description: App name or plain-language description, such as purple icons.

category.description: Case-insensitive category: Books, Business, Development, Education, Entertainment, Finance, Food & Drink, Games, Graphics & Design, Health & Fitness, Lifestyle, Music, Navigation, News, Photo & Video, Productivity, Shopping, Social Networking, Sports, Travel, Utilities, Weather.

platform.description: Case-insensitive platform: iOS, macOS, Windows, watchOS, visionOS.

sort.description:
Featured order, alphabetical or reverse alphabetical. With q, featured means best match first.

Provider reference: allowed values ["featured", "az", "za"]; default "featured".

limit.description:
Icons per page, integer 1 to 100. Defaults to 24.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 24.

offset.description:
Zero-based integer offset for pagination.

Provider reference: minimum 0; default 0.

200.description:
Icon summaries under results, alongside total, limit and offset. Advance offset by limit for the next page.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.
